questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The book was written by the author over a period of two years.

options.text: The author wrote the book over a period of two years.
The book was written over a period of two years.
The book was being written by the author over a period of two years.
The period of two years was taken by the author to write the book.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"The author wrote the book over a period of two years."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. It is in Simple Past Tense.
 
• As per the given question, we must change it to Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• In the passive voice, the subject is "book" and the object is "author."
 
• "Author" is the subject and "book" is the object in the active voice.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence: *The author wrote the book over a period of two years.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. through the streets of London on a single day in June 1923

B. the novel is as patterned as a Post-Impressionist painting

C. can trace Clarissa’s and Septimus’s movements

D. but is also so accurately representational that the reader
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"B, D, C, A".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Sentence B ("the novel is as patterned as a Post-Impressionist painting") serves as a good starting point, as it gives a general statement about the novel.
 
• After making a claim about the novel's structure, Sentence D comes next because it provides a contrasting point to Sentence B. It maintains the topic of the novel's nature, but introduces a different angle, the accurate representation in the novel, which builds onto the original statement.
 
• Sentence C logically follows sentence D. This is because sentence D ends with "that the reader", which needs to be followed by an action that the reader can perform. Sentence C provides this action.
 
• Sentence A fits last because it provides specific information about where and when the reader can trace the characters' movements, nicely concluding the description started in sentence C.

 

Complete sentence: **"The novel is as patterned as a Post-Impressionist painting, but is also so accurately representational that the reader can trace Clarissa’s and Septimus’s movements through the streets of London on a single day in June 1923."**

questions.question:
**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. The prosperity and business acumen

B. Mumbai and Kolkata indicate that in the commercial sector

C. Of the great industrial and commercial houses in

D. India has a considerable potential for modernisation
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"A, C, B, D."****
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence should start with the subject, which is **"The prosperity and business acumen"** in this case.
 
• So, the first part is A**.
 
• The next part should be the **noun** + preposition, which is **"The prosperity and business acumen of the great industrial and commercial houses in."**
 
• So, the next part is C.
 
• Then, we need to add the object, which is "**Mumbai and Kolkata indicate that in the commercial sector​."**
 
• So, the next part is **B**.
 
• The last part must be **D** as it provides the remaining portion of the sentence. 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• **Correct sentence**: *The prosperity and business acumen of the great industrial and commercial houses in Mumbai and Kolkata indicate that in the commercial sector India has a considerable potential for modernisation.*
